description:
Internationalize the 'LibraryApp' Java project by externalizing hardcoded strings.

The project is located at `~/eclipse-workspace/LibraryApp`. If it is not visible in the Package Explorer, import it first (File > Import > Maven > Existing Maven Projects).

Your goal is to use Eclipse's **Source > Externalize Strings...** wizard on the `src/main/java/com/library/app/LibraryApp.java` file.

**Requirements:**
1. Extract ALL user-facing strings (menu options, prompts, success/error messages) into a resource bundle.
2. You may mark technical strings (like switch case constants "1", "2") as 'Never Externalize'.
3. Use the default bundle name `messages.properties` and accessor class `Messages.java`.
4. Ensure the files are created in the `com.library.app` package.
5. Verify the project compiles without errors after refactoring.
6. Save all modified files.
